data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For a small team, my top recommendation is **1Password**\. It offers the best overall balance of security, ease of use, shared credentials and administration without becoming overly complicated.

However, there are a few strong alternatives depending on your budget, team size and security requirements.

## Best password managers for small teams

![Use 1Password to pay with Brex virtual cards | 1Password Support](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/jW9m5r8B1OOoC9_iuUqtcbuFvRIssDo1xPEle05zyivsAzEccjdiNdtubob2MvSNHBNNbAJEgPF2shn3XjCQVF2UpYLQBFqIHhPpMLW-2IdPYFVkBAUQX3sKrTTTW_dUxH7pFERSCFMY35jYZ7bBA0nUCDV1teFYW8VXkufFXOpp7NCKHSyZGJd82t1b0lls?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall experience)

- Excellent shared vaults and access permissions.
- Easy for non-technical employees.
- Good admin controls and security reporting.
- Particularly good for teams that share logins across departments.

**My pick if ease of use matters most.**

Teams Starter Pack: approximately \$24.95/month for up to 10 users. Business plan costs more.

[1Password for Business](https://1password.com/business/)

---

![Bitwarden Tutorial: The Best Free Password Manager](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/yQdA_GKvtZ_3I7QA0Sm0LkvONkaQLVaUdTczG3x2pi_nlJK2KRNC9oBCulE9SnOW7J6TqO-Ome_JAcewWmNFPEWbXjKFEKASqM0jN1JqmZ7zWsxSqlz4JsfL5HVoABXbQdTAQpY4FJFIY0KTyOUFIN8OIvNgH7f9Pt3yeOSRhxPLlvlVTBFhFWzmu9R_sd3K?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

- Open-source software.
- Strong shared collections and permissions.
- Good administration and audit logs.
- Self-hosting option for organisations that want more control.

**My pick if you want excellent security without spending too much.**

Teams: approximately \$4 per user/month, billed annually.

[Bitwarden Business](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Password Manager Reviews 2026: Details, Pricing, & Features | G2](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/5Ez9xjcnz5j_5Y0V-PIfrw8gFITpb9bDLaYYBmHMoMrWqYvM0bYfjbERPYatfi4xUQH2V4vDEtnJG0sN-w9VKPkNsVNx9dVJVxa2DyKcmrM63SD5Ns97gXtvYi5F1Y8oit0Oi-xhLNolWJuRxmLo71sCVzvwOugIOoBWz4PVsApM40vN8LY491iRo6wy7k1w?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

- Strong administrative controls.
- Shared folders and delegated administration.
- Good additional security and compliance features.

**Best if you have stricter security or compliance requirements.**

Business Starter pricing has been listed around \$2 per user/month.

[Keeper Business](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/GVmyZL2MRgnYs-ev4BRZt__glcCCRKJnE0LcKVPH5v_D-MrA5yoWT1VyOFlGbNUrhmEj_FMXd_HpRYsEWvAurx5gn-O12raHgfMg5Sudeva1eef14FYiQa0ayrST5ojk233wKJx5uVSdScZEKqXxooXyS8_kckoexumh5UKz3pfcejgPm6izYaVE8Ge6qiyT?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

- Privacy-focused approach.
- Secure sharing and team vaults.
- Good option for privacy-conscious European businesses.

**Best if privacy and the wider Proton ecosystem matter.**

[Proton Pass for Business](https://proton.me/business/pass)

The comparisons and indicative prices are based on 2026 plan information. Features and prices vary by subscription tier. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.openideurope.eu](https://www.openideurope.eu/reviews/password-managers-for-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to these two\:

| If you prioritise... | Choose |
|--------|--------|
| Simplicity and employee adoption | **1Password** |
| Value for money and flexibility | **Bitwarden** |
| Advanced security administration | Keeper |
| Privacy-focused ecosystem | Proton Pass |


Whichever you choose, make sure it supports\:

- Individual employee accounts (never one shared master account).
- Shared vaults with role-based permissions.
- Two-factor authentication.
- Immediate access removal when someone leaves.
- Audit logs and secure password sharing.
